badge.$description: Badge. Component tokens are the customisation point for one component. They reference SEMANTIC tokens — by token path when the value is theme-agnostic, or through the semantic CSS variable (--qx-color-*) when it is theme-varying, so one declaration covers both themes. A component token must never reference another component's tokens. Everything lives under the `component.*` namespace: the shadcn bridge already publishes leaves named `input`, `card`, `radius` and so on, and a token path cannot be both a leaf and a group.

border.$description: The hairline that gives a tinted badge (brand, info, success, warning, destructive) its shape: 30% of the tone's text hue mixed into its own subtle surface. The subtle surfaces are 1.07:1 against a white card, so without the edge a status badge read as coloured text. Same recipe and weight as the Alert family's status border (1.5:1 light, 1.8:1 dark), and drawn as a border so forced-colors mode keeps the outline.
